templates.account_positioning: Academic productivity account using familiar research interfaces, status-upgrade hooks, and simple screen-recorded workflows to make research tools feel immediately useful.
templates.main_content_logic: Status-gap hook -> strong website CTA -> short command chain -> tip/proof setup -> finished academic output proof.

visible_sequence: How to write your thesis paper like a PhD/Master student (The easy way)
Just go to this website!
Click researcher
Type your research paper topic
Pro tip! use latex for pdfs
Then watch it do its magic in 2-3 mins
It's done! let's see...
A complete research paper!
With meaningful visualizations!
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Status-upgrade hook with parenthetical qualifier, exclamation CTA, short command captions, Pro tip!, ellipsis before reveal, exclamation result proof.
caption_logic.hook_formula: How to [do academic task] like a [higher-status academic identity] ([easy/smart/legit way])
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve status-gap hook, early CTA, command chain, reveal setup, and proof ending. Replace unsupported time/completion claims with product-safe proof.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not imply the product writes a complete paper for submission.
Do not copy Google Scholar branding as product affiliation.
Replace exact time promises with safer phrases unless measured.
Keep the sentence rhythm and roles, not the original claims.

templates.account_positioning: Student-life creator using fear, casual confession, and quick laptop proof to make an academic workflow shortcut feel like an insider tip.
templates.main_content_logic: Authority warning or student fear -> creator reaction/confession -> one-step tool action -> fast result proof -> emotional release.

visible_sequence: My professor said he can tell if we use AI for our assignments...
So I check my sources first
and boom, now I know what to fix 😭
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Lowercase casual confession, quoted authority warning, ellipsis after fear setup, and boom result reveal, emoji at relief moment.
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve fear-to-relief rhythm. Rewrite unsafe bypass/detector logic into ethical checking, verifying, organizing, or editing support.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not promise bypassing AI detection.
Do not encourage academic dishonesty.
Keep the human anxiety hook, but convert the action into ethical review or verification.
Use one clear proof moment instead of a long feature tour.

templates.account_positioning: Real-person creator hook library using Xiaoyu's selfie reactions to make the first seconds feel human before product footage starts.
templates.main_content_logic: Xiaoyu reaction hook -> product reveal -> workflow proof -> result proof or emotional release.

visible_sequence: Short pain or surprise caption over Xiaoyu reaction
Immediate product UI reveal
One clear product action
Result proof
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Short high-emotion first line, then direct action/result captions.
caption_logic.hook_formula: [High-anxiety or surprising problem] + Xiaoyu matching facial reaction
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Use Xiaoyu only as the opening human hook. Continue the rest of the edit with product footage from the active product library.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not use Xiaoyu reaction footage as product proof.
Do not imply the reaction clip is generated by the product.
Match the chosen Xiaoyu clip emotion to the script pain: confused, panicked, shocked, or caught off guard.
For Clearfy, keep AI-rate and humanizer claims product-safe and avoid promising guaranteed detector bypass.

templates.account_positioning: Student/research productivity account using late-night academic pain, handheld paper/laptop proof, and emotional relief to frame research workflows as time-saving study help.
templates.main_content_logic: Sleepless-night pain hook -> tool value promise -> simple topic input -> relevant paper/result proof -> finished starting point -> relief ending.

visible_sequence: saying goodbye to my sleepless night because i can now start my rrl faster 🥹🥹🥹
this gives me research papers that are curated and relevant 🧑‍💻✨
just type your topic and let it find the papers 🪄✨
relevant research papers in seconds 🥰✨
my review finally has a starting point, goodnight world 🥱💤
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: All lowercase, emotional student phrasing, short lines, cute emojis, soft no-hard-sell CTA, relief ending.
caption_logic.hook_formula: saying goodbye to my [study pain] because i can now [safe progress outcome]
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve lowercase emotional study rhythm and relief arc. Replace exact time/quantity promises with safe measured or softer claims.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not promise a full assignment, RRL, or paper is finished automatically.
Do not use exact time claims unless verified.
Keep the late-night pain and relief emotion, but frame the result as a starting point or checked workflow.
Use emojis sparingly and only where the template expects emotional release.

templates.account_positioning: Study creator using a close selfie panic reaction, professor-surveillance anxiety, and a hard cut to laptop/document proof.
templates.main_content_logic: Close selfie academic panic -> professors are evolving caption -> hard cut to laptop proof -> product workflow that creates or checks evidence.

ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.person_expression: student creator, anxious/amused, caught off guard, half-covering mouth
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.action: close selfie, hand partially covering mouth, eye contact, small glance toward laptop before proof cut
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.atmosphere: academic deadline or submission anxiety with a playful studytok tone
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.framing: vertical 9:16 close selfie, face in upper half, lower-middle caption-safe area
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.camera_motion: subtle handheld selfie drift; no speaking or lip-sync
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.differentiation_rule: reuse emotional function and close-selfie grammar only; change face, outfit, room, props, lighting, camera distance, and gesture timing

visible_sequence: bro... professors are evolving...
hard cut to document / product proof
proof that the student checked, traced, edited, or kept a workflow trail
caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Lowercase bro... setup, ellipsis for panic/comedy, short proof captions after hard cut.
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve the professor-evolving panic and hard cut to proof. Rewrite the proof around product-safe evidence, checking, editing, or source-tracing workflows.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not copy the reference creator face, clothing, room, or exact pose timing.
Do not generate speaking or lip-sync in the AI human clip; burn hook text later as captions.
Do not use unsupported academic misconduct claims or detector-bypass promises.
Avoid unsupported guarantees; keep proof to visible product workflow.

templates.main_content_logic: Close selfie proof-pride hook -> document reveal -> writing/process report -> activity/typing proof -> paste or AI-risk check evidence.

ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.atmosphere: study desk, essay/submission context, playful academic pride with mild sarcasm
ai_human_hook_visual_grammar.framing: vertical 9:16 extreme close-up selfie, lower-middle caption-safe area

caption_logic.punctuation_pattern: Lowercase casual sentence, long first-line flex/complaint, then short proof captions on screen recordings.
caption_logic.hook_formula: showing off the [work/output] i [did/checked/made] without [bad workflow/shortcut] cuz why has everyone forgotten how to [basic skill]
caption_logic.reuse_rule: Preserve the self-authorship/process-proof flex. Rewrite around ethical product workflows: source trail, citation check, editable figure trail, or reviewed draft. Avoid claiming the product proves authorship unless the visible workflow supports it.

rewrite_boundaries: Do not claim a product proves the user wrote every word unless that feature exists and is shown.
Do not encourage bypassing AI detectors or academic misconduct.
Do not copy the reference creator face, outfit, room, or exact pose timing.
Generated AI human hooks must be silent reaction clips; burn captions later.
For product rewrites, make the proof match visible product footage: source trail, citation match, editable figure, or revision/check workflow.
